title: Pondering Pebble Puffer
statement: This small, speckled puffer spends its days patiently arranging sand and pebbles into intricate spirals beneath a soft moonlit glow, pausing often to tilt its head as if asking a question. Each time a pattern is finished, its spots shimmer gold for a moment of quiet delight, and then it gently smooths the sand and begins something new.
